sentences.text: Workday appointed co-founder and Executive Chair Aneel Bhusri as chief executive officer effective February 6, 2026, with Carl Eschenbach ceasing to serve as CEO and resigning from the board; Eschenbach remains as strategic advisor to the CEO.
Bhusri framed the move around AI, calling it a bigger transformation than SaaS and saying he would work alongside presidents Gerrit Kazmaier and Rob Enslin.
His pay package includes a $1,250,000 base salary, a target bonus of up to 200% of salary from fiscal 2027, and a restricted stock unit award valued at $60,000,000 at grant.
